# FairShare — Household Logistics Operating System

> The calm, single-assignee household logistics platform with store geofencing, recurring staples, and direct mobile phone calling.

## Core Architectural Modules
- [Errand Kanban & Delegated Requests](https://familyessentials.app/features/errands): Single named ownership, urgency badges, and real-time state tracking.
- [Store Geofencing & Location Reminders](https://familyessentials.app/features/geofencing): 150m arrival detection at frequent supermarkets and pharmacies.
- [Recurring Household Staples](https://familyessentials.app/features/recurring): Weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly automated task generation with pause controls.
- [Shared Family Ledger & Budgets](https://familyessentials.app/features/money): Lightweight, bank-free expense tracking with Owner, Manager, and Summary roles.
- [Direct Phone Escalation](https://familyessentials.app/features/escalation): Direct native mobile phone calling for urgent household errands.
- [Multi-Tenant Security & Family Roles](https://familyessentials.app/features/roles): Row-level PostgreSQL database isolation with Admin, Adult, Teen, and Child roles.

## Specialized Household Solutions
- [Busy Working Parents](https://familyessentials.app/solutions/busy-parents): Eliminating the invisible cognitive load for dual-career couples.
- [Co-Parents & Blended Families](https://familyessentials.app/solutions/co-parenting): Transparent expense splits and neutral accountability across separate homes.

## Company & Resources
- [Transparent Pricing Plans](https://familyessentials.app/pricing): Starter Family free for up to 2 members, Pilot Family ($14.99/mo), Household Pro ($24.99/mo), and Enterprise Household ($49.99/mo).
- [About FairShare](https://familyessentials.app/about): Our mission, vision and the team behind the product.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://familyessentials.app/faq): Technical and operational answers about geofencing, battery life, and privacy.
- [Contact Support](https://familyessentials.app/contact): Direct assistance with a guaranteed response time under 12 hours.
